# Clockwork Automation

> Business automation consulting for small businesses in San Diego County, California. Clockwork Automation builds systems that automate collections and accounts receivable, lead follow-up, customer communications and owner reporting.

## The Clockwork Suite (tools that all run on one CRM hub the client owns; pick any combination, chosen together on the first call)
- Clockwork Collect (collections): daily refresh of overdue accounts, stage-based reminder texts and emails, a prioritized call list, and payment tracking.
- Clockwork Follow-Up (lead follow-up): lead capture, quote follow-up sequences, rebooking reminders and review requests.
- Clockwork Connect (phones and texting): business numbers and two-way texting set up and supported by Clockwork Automation, with every call and text logged to the CRM hub.
- Clockwork Pulse (owner dashboard): weekly business numbers in one automatically updated view.
- Full Clockwork Suite: all four tools connected, at a bundle price.

## Ongoing services
- Fractional operations: part-time head of operations with a weekly operations meeting, monthly dashboard review, up to about 10 hours of hands-on process work and team coaching; $2,500 to $4,000 per month.
- Coaching and training: team sessions on the system, priced per session or included with fractional operations.

## Pricing
- Money-leak call: free, 30 minutes.
- Automation audit: $500, credited toward a build.
- Build: fixed price, quoted after the audit.
- Monthly support: Essentials $500 per month; Growth $1,200 per month.

## Results
- A San Diego portable storage company went from about 4 to 50 collection calls per day with the same collector after its AR process was automated.

## Founder
Jeremy, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran who served in communications, founded Clockwork Automation after running operations, sales and collections at a San Diego company.

## Who it serves
Owner-run businesses with 5 to 25 employees, including property managers, cleaning services, contractors, HVAC and plumbing, landscaping, med spas, and storage and moving companies.

Stop chasing rent every month.
- [Missed-Call Text-Back and Follow-Up for San Diego HVAC and Plumbing Companies](https://clockworkautomationsd.com/missed-call-text-back-hvac-plumbing-san-diego/): Turn missed calls into booked jobs. Instant text-back, one lead list and automatic follow-up for San Diego HVAC and plumbing companies.
- [Quote Follow-Up Automation for San Diego Contractors and Landscapers](https://clockworkautomationsd.com/quote-follow-up-contractors-landscapers-san-diego/): Automatic quote and estimate follow-up for San Diego contractors and landscapers. Turn the bids you already wrote into signed jobs.
- [Rebooking and Review Requests for San Diego Cleaning Companies and Med Spas](https://clockworkautomationsd.com/rebooking-review-requests-cleaning-med-spa-san-diego/): Automatic rebooking reminders, appointment confirmations and Google review requests for San Diego cleaning companies and med spas.
- [Fractional Operations for San Diego Small Businesses](https://clockworkautomationsd.com/fractional-operations-san-diego/): A part-time head of operations for San Diego small businesses: weekly ops meetings, dashboard reviews, hands-on process fixes and team coaching.
